name.value: Super 8 by Wyndham Kamloops On The Hill

description.value: Super 8 by Wyndham Kamloops On The Hill is a franchise motel situated on the hill above Kamloops at 1521 Hugh Allan Drive, part of the well-known Super 8 budget chain under the Wyndham Hotels umbrella. It offers standard motel-style accommodation in a city that sits at the crossroads of several major touring routes through the BC Interior. Touring cyclists passing through Kamloops would find it a familiar, no-frills overnight base close to the Trans-Canada and Coquihalla corridors.
